items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: I did an album with Charles. I did a tour with him.

ctx.x: Didn't you do something recently with Charles Brown? Something with Charles Brown?

I did an album with Charles. I did a tour with him. Charles Brown's album must have been about two, three years ago. I did something in Washington, D.C. We did a concert from the album in Oakland, California, the Oakland Symphony. I wrote for that. Oh, man. I know there's somebody in between. But I still can do it. Oh, it's obvious.

Yeah. Yeah. Um. We're almost finished with this reel. Uh. Well, we can leave it at that. At some point, if I ever, we want to do another follow up at some point. Call me. There's some things, there's a few things here we didn't get to, but we can, you know, at some point. Oh, I wanted to do that.
